title: Sea and Islands
statementMd:
A map of some object is a rectangular field consisting of $*n*$ rows and $*n*$ columns. Each cell is initially occupied by the sea but you can cover some some cells of the map with sand so that exactly $*k*$ islands appear on the map. We will call a set of sand cells to be **island** if it is possible to get from each of them to each of them by moving only through sand cells and by moving from a cell only to a side-adjacent cell. The cells are called to be side-adjacent if they share a vertical or horizontal side. It is easy to see that islands do not share cells (otherwise they together form a bigger island).

Find a way to cover some cells with sand so that exactly $*k*$ islands appear on the $*n* × *n*$ map, or determine that no such way exists.

## Input

The single line contains two positive integers $*n*$, $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $0 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*^{2}$) — the size of the map and the number of islands you should form.

## Output

If the answer doesn't exist, print "NO" (without the quotes) in a single line.

Otherwise, print "YES" in the first line. In the next $*n*$ lines print the description of the map. Each of the lines of the description must consist only of characters `'S'` and `'L'`, where `'S'` is a cell that is occupied by the sea and `'L'` is the cell covered with sand. The length of each line of the description must equal $*n*$.

If there are multiple answers, you may print any of them.

You **should not** maximize the sizes of islands.
statementZhMd:
一张地图是一个由 $*n*$ 行 $*n*$ 列组成的矩形区域。初始时每个格子都被海水占据，但你可以用沙子覆盖地图上的一些格子，使地图上恰好出现 $*k*$ 个岛屿。如果一组沙地格子中的任意两个格子之间，都可以仅通过沙地格子移动到达，且每次只能从一个格子移动到与其边相邻的格子，那么我们称这组沙地格子为一个**岛屿**。如果两个格子共享一条水平边或垂直边，则称它们边相邻。显然，岛屿之间不会共享格子（否则它们会共同组成一个更大的岛屿）。

请找出一种用沙子覆盖一些格子的方案，使 $*n* × *n*$ 的地图上恰好出现 $*k*$ 个岛屿，或者判断不存在这样的方案。

## 输入格式

一行包含两个正整数 $*n*$、$*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$，$0 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*^{2}$），分别表示地图的大小和需要形成的岛屿数量。

## 输出格式

如果不存在满足条件的方案，请在一行中输出 `NO`（不含引号）。

否则，第一行输出 `YES`。接下来的 $*n*$ 行输出地图的描述。描述中的每一行只能由字符 `'S'` 和 `'L'` 组成，其中 `'S'` 表示被海水占据的格子，`'L'` 表示被沙子覆盖的格子。每行的长度必须等于 $*n*$。

如果存在多个答案，可以输出其中任意一个。

你**不应**最大化岛屿的大小。
